question: Who wins the Michigan Senate race in 2026
quote: But I agree. I think he's going to win.
turn_text: Yeah. Well, this is the one I most hope I'm wrong on, of course. But I agree. I think he's going to win. I was talking to someone close to the Rogers campaign who's deeply committed to Rogers winning who said prior to the Stevens thing, he referred to the campaign as dead in the water in terms of, I guess, the internal polling. I just don't think Stevens is enough to move. It involves an endorsement, which they just don't – they don't mean as much as they used to. It's a little complicated because she had endorsed him and then unendorsed him. And as you guys were pointing out, a lot of the early vote is already in. So I don't think it's going to really move the needle, at least not enough. So unfortunately, I'm there too. Now, that keeps the Democratic pickups the same for the rest of us because this is – for all of us because this would be a Democratic hold, which takes us, speaking of the heartland, which MBD just mentioned, Jim Garrity, to Ohio. We have Republican Senator John Husted trying to hold on against former Democratic Senator Sherrod Brown.
host_quote: And that takes us, Jim Garrity, to the aforementioned Michigan.
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Michigan US Senate general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: AP: Progressive Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate race
